useCase: Verifying 阴影 consistency 以检测 AI generation or image compositing
mechanism: 检测 阴影 edges and estimates 阴影 direction vectors using 梯度 分析. 检查 that all 阴影s in the scene are consistent with a single (or known) light source configuration. AI images frequently produce 阴影s cast in contradictory directions or with inconsistent softness/hardness.
accuracy: 中等 - 68-78% on images with clearly visible 阴影s
name: 阴影一致性分析
source: Kee et al. (2013) - Exposing Digital Forgeries from Cast Shadows, ACM TOMM
algorithm: Shadow Edge Detection + Vanishing Point Analysis
parameters: Shadow 检测: chromaticity-based segmentation, Direction estimation: Radon transform on 阴影 boundaries, Consistency: pairwise angular comparison, Softness: penumbra width 分析
description: 分析 阴影 geometry, direction, and softness for physical plausibility. AI models struggle to maintain consistent 阴影 casting from a single light source.

references.title: Kee, E. et al. (2013). Exposing Digital Photo Manipulation with Inconsistent Shadows. ACM TOMM.
Zhang, W. et al. (2009). Detecting Image Splicing by Illumination Color Estimation. IWDW.

strengths:
• Physics-based approach with strong theoretical basis
• Effective for outdoor scenes with clear 阴影s
• Complements lighting 分析 methods
• Can detect both AI and manual 篡改
limitations:
• Requires clearly visible 阴影 regions
• Overcast/indoor scenes with soft lighting are difficult
• Multiple light sources complicate 分析
• Transparent or translucent objects create complex 阴影s
